assessments.rationale: Both involve an exploratory step to discover distinct entities that will become the primary units (houses/classes) in the subsequent design.

assessments.source_element: different types of houses (colonial, ranch, Victorian)
assessments.rationale: The categorization of house styles maps directly to the definition of classes as distinct types in OOAD.
Attributes describe static properties of an entity; number of rooms is a property analogous to class attributes.
Methods represent behaviors an object can perform, just as a heating system is a functional capability of a house.
Both steps produce a precise, visual plan that guides the later construction/implementation.
Inheritance is a hierarchical type relationship, not merely component reuse; bathroom layouts illustrate reuse but omit the subtype‑supertype semantics.

assessments.source_element: organizing blueprints into sections (plumbing, electrical, structural)
assessments.rationale: Encapsulation also entails information hiding and controlled access, which the analogy of sectioning blueprints does not capture.
The physical connections between rooms parallel object associations that define how instances relate.

assessments.source_element: plumbing system interacting with multiple rooms
assessments.rationale: A system linking many rooms mirrors many‑to‑many associations in OOAD.

assessments.source_element: modular kitchen that can be configured in different ways
assessments.rationale: Polymorphism concerns substitutable types and dynamic method dispatch; a configurable kitchen suggests modularity rather than type substitutability.

assessments.source_element: reviewing blueprints with family, contractors, inspectors using visual models
assessments.rationale: Both use visual artifacts to convey design intent to non‑technical participants.

structural_issues: Inheritance is reduced to simple component reuse, missing the hierarchical subtype relationship.
Encapsulation is portrayed only as organizational grouping, omitting information hiding and access control.
Polymorphism is equated with modular configurability, which does not capture dynamic dispatch or substitutability.
The analogy does not address the iterative nature of OOAD (refinement, validation) beyond the initial blueprint stage.
result.rationale: Most mappings align well, but key OOAD concepts (inheritance, encapsulation, polymorphism) are represented only loosely, requiring logical leaps. The overall correspondence is therefore moderate rather than fully sound.
